# Font Awesome Free

Self-hosted Font Awesome Free 6.7.2, taken unchanged from the official
`@fortawesome/fontawesome-free` npm package. Core and solid CSS plus their
WOFF2/TTF font files are included; no CDN, kit, or JavaScript dependency.
The shared root layout loads both stylesheets.

See LICENSE.txt for the upstream licenses and copyright notices.
Upstream: https://github.com/FortAwesome/Font-Awesome
